"""Publish actual V165 CUDA/smoke/prefix readiness without a quality claim."""
import json
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import psutil
import torch
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V165-pair-common-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);post=read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json');guard(post)
smoke=read(root/'smoke-result-v1.json');assert smoke['counts']==smoke['updates']=={'fine-control':10,'pair-common':10}
assert smoke['exact_V164_control_trace_rows']==10
state=torch.load(smoke['checkpoint']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
for arm in state['arms']:
 assert len(state['models'][arm])==len(state['emas'][arm])==len(state['optimizers'][arm]['state'])==47
 assert all(float(s['step'])==10 for s in state['optimizers'][arm]['state'].values())
 assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for k in ['models','emas'] for v in state[k][arm].values())
 assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for s in state['optimizers'][arm]['state'].values() for v in s.values())
assert all(min(v.values())>0 for v in smoke['parameter_maximum_gradients'].values())
parity=read(root/'parity-result-v1.json');assert len(parity['rows'])==28 and parity['component_forward_evaluations']==56
anchor=parity['CUDA_anchor_loss_checks'];pair=parity['CUDA_pair_unit_loss_checks'];common=parity['CUDA_pair_common_loss_checks']
assert len(anchor)==10 and len(pair)==6 and len(common)==4
assert common[-1]['ADC_zero_weight'] and common[-1]['loss']==0
snapshot=root/'readiness-training-prefix-v1.jsonl';assert not snapshot.exists()
with (root/'train-trace-v1.jsonl').open() as stream:lines=[next(stream) for _ in range(40)]
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in lines];baseline=read(plan['baseline_training']['path'])['trace'];table=read(plan['pair_unit_table']['path'])['rows']
cache=read(plan['cache']['path'])['batches'];active=0
for i,row in enumerate(rows):
 old=baseline[i];assert all(row[k]==old[k] for k in ['step','batch','domain','flat_target_mask'])
 expected=old['arms']['fine-pair'];assert {k:row['arms']['fine-control'][k] for k in expected}==expected
 assert row['arms']['fine-control']['pair_common_error']==0
 entry=table[i];values=np.array(entry['candidate_units_FP32'],dtype=np.float32).reshape(entry['shape'])
 for arm in ['fine-control','pair-common']:
  assert row['arms'][arm]['pair_unit_values']==fingerprint(values) and row['arms'][arm]['pair_unit_floor_DN16']==2
  if cache[i]['metadata']['noise']['shot']==cache[i]['metadata']['noise']['read']==0:assert row['arms'][arm]['loss']==row['arms'][arm]['gradient_norm']==0
 if len(values):
  assert row['arms']['pair-common']['pair_common_error']>=0;active+=1
 else:assert row['arms']['pair-common']['pair_common_error']==0
snapshot.write_text(''.join(lines))
status=read(root/'status-v1.json');queued=read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')
assert status['status']=='running-declared-phase' and status['phase']=='train' and queued['status']=='waiting-for-original-training-owner'
owners=[]
for role,o in [('training-controller',status['owner']),('train-worker',status['child']),('review-controller',queued['owner'])]:
 assert live(o);owners.append({'role':role,**o,'argv':psutil.Process(o['pid']).cmdline()})
snapshot_live=root/'prepared-live-snapshot-v1.json';assert not snapshot_live.exists()
save(snapshot_live,{'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'training':status,'postprocess':queued,'progress':read(root/'train-progress-v1.json'),
 'observed_live_owners':owners,'scope':'Historical observed original-live snapshot,not final counts or quality. No restart.'})
audit=root/'readiness-audit-v1.json';assert not audit.exists()
save(audit,{'status':'pass-restored-smoke-exact-control-prefix-and-common-loss-routing',
 'smoke':ref(root/'smoke-result-v1.json'),'finite_Adam_states_at10':94,
 'all94_parameter_tensors_have_finite_nonzero_prefix_gradients':True,'exact_V164_control_prefix_rows':40,
 'exact_training_masks_and_pair_unit_records':40,'training_prefix':ref(snapshot),'paired_prefix_batches_with_candidate_common_term':active,
 'smoke_peak_CUDA_bytes':smoke['CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes'],'independent_CUDA_anchor_leaf_backwards':10,
 'independent_CUDA_pair_leaf_backwards':6,'independent_CUDA_common_leaf_backwards':4,
 'maximum_CUDA_common_loss_adjoint_difference':max(v['maximum_full_output_adjoint_difference'] for v in common),
 'new_neural_forwards':0,'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
protocol=root/'protocol-document-v1.md';assert not protocol.exists();shutil.copyfile(repo/'docs/pair-common-error.md',protocol)
dest=repo/'docs/results/v165-pair-common-preparation-v1';dest.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
names={'plan.json':'plan-v1.json','quality-design.json':'quality-design-v1.json','CPU-readiness.json':'CPU-readiness-v1.json',
 'parity.json':'parity-result-v1.json','smoke.json':'smoke-result-v1.json','readiness-audit.json':'readiness-audit-v1.json',
 'training-prefix.jsonl':snapshot.name,'live-snapshot.json':snapshot_live.name,'postprocess-imports.json':'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json',
 'postprocess-plan.json':'postprocess-plan-v1.json','retained-native-comparators.json':'native-retained-comparators-v1.json','original-protocol.md':protocol.name}
originals={name:root/path for name,path in names.items()}
originals.update({'unit-inputs.json':Path(plan['pair_unit_table']['path']),'motivation.json':repo/'docs/results/v165-pair-common-motivation-v1.json',
 'CPU-regression.log':repo/'.cache/v165-CPU-regression-v1.log','new-common-tests.log':repo/'.cache/v165-common-loss-tests-v1.log'})
copies={}
for name,p in originals.items():
 q=dest/name;shutil.copyfile(p,q);assert q.read_bytes()==p.read_bytes();copies[name]={'original':ref(p),'public':ref(q)}
paths=list((Path(plan['work'])/'scripts').glob('*.py'))+list((Path(plan['work'])/'configs').glob('*'))+list((root/'postprocess-v1/scripts').glob('*.py'))
tests=read(root/'CPU-readiness-v1.json')['tests']['command'].split(' pytest ',1)[1].split(' -q')[0].split();paths += [repo/p for p in tests]
paths += [repo/p for p in ['scripts/paired_common_objective.py','scripts/train_pair_common_trial.py','scripts/review_pair_common_trial.py',
 'configs/quality-v143-pair-common-v165.yaml','.cache/probe-v165-pair-common-v1.py','.cache/build-v165-controller-v1.py',
 '.cache/prepare-v165-postprocess-v1.py','.cache/launch-v165-v1.py','.cache/queue-v165-review-v1.py','.cache/launch-v165-queue-v1.py']]
paths=list(dict.fromkeys(paths));neural={p:h for p,h in plan['frozen_files'].items() if Path(p).parent.name=='demosaic'};assert len(neural)==89
for p,h in neural.items():assert ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==h
bundle=dest/'source-bundle-v1.json';save(bundle,{'source_texts':[dict(ref(p),text=p.read_text()) for p in paths],
 'unchanged_neural_hashes':neural,'publisher':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
index=repo/'docs/results/v165-pair-common-preparation-v1.json';assert not index.exists()
save(index,{'status':'ready-original-training-live-quality-pending','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'copies':copies,'sources':ref(bundle),
 'source_texts':len(paths),'unchanged_neural_sources':89,'new_neural_modules':0,'parameters_per_head':124909,'parameter_tensors_per_head':47,
 'pair_unit_floor_DN16_both':2,'pair_common_unit_DN16':16,'pair_common_weights':{'control':0,'candidate':1},'flat_anchor_weight_both':.25,
 'actual_CPU_tests':221,'new_common_checks':22,'compatibility_contexts':28,'compatibility_head_calls':56,
 'additional_parity_leaf_output_CUDA_backwards':20,'motivation_head_calls':12,'motivation_head_images':48,'motivation_leaf_backwards':12,
 'discarded_smoke_head_calls':20,'finite_Adam_states_after_restored_smoke':94,'exact_V164_control_prefix_rows':40,
 'fixed_heads':2,'fixed_endpoints':4,'steps_per_head':1000,'review_cases':822,'planned_review_calls':3288,
 'planned_main_scientific_head_calls':5364,'planned_main_head_images':11424,'planned_total_root_calls_including_motivation':5376,
 'planned_total_head_images_including_motivation':11472,'planned_new_main_prediction_arrays':1644,
 'actual_motivation_batch_arrays':12,'planned_native_images':72,'planned_triplets':24,'retained_native_columns':8,'planned_native_RGB_channels':61824000,
 'quality_complete':False,'performance_native_viewing_complete':False,'new_parent_DINO_source_noise_calls':0,'original_lookups':0,'RAW_decodes':0,'scope':plan['scope']})
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
print('Published',len(copies),'exact receipts,',len(paths),'source texts,89 unchanged neural modules,40 exact control/unit/common records;original3 owners live')
